steps.code:
# Fetch each playlist and compute downloaded song coverage
downloaded_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in downloaded_songs}
playlist_ids = [p['playlist_id'] for p in playlists]
print("Playlist IDs:", playlist_ids)

for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    dl_songs = [s for s in songs if s['id'] in downloaded_ids]
    total_duration = sum(d['duration'] for d in downloaded_songs if d['song_id'] in {s['id'] for s in dl_songs})
    print(f"Playlist {pid} ({pl['title']}): total songs={len(songs)}, downloaded={len(dl_songs)}, downloaded_duration={total_duration}s")
